option_relations.rationale: The clinical presentation and diagnostic findings, including the presence of lymphoma cells in the cerebrospinal fluid and the brain biopsy results, are consistent with Primary Central Nervous System Lymphoma (PCNSL).
Intravascular large B-cell lymphoma is a distinct entity that primarily affects the blood vessels, and the clinical presentation and diagnostic findings do not support this diagnosis.
Secondary CNS involvement by systemic diffuse large B-cell lymphoma would typically be associated with a history of systemic lymphoma, which is not mentioned in the case.
Lymphomatosis cerebri variant of diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL) is a rare entity, and the clinical presentation and diagnostic findings do not support this diagnosis.
